gloss: to mix and match (clothes); to wear in rotation

definitions.gloss: to mix and match (clothes); to wear in rotation
definitions.explanation: To wear a small number of clothes in many different combinations, or to keep wearing the same few items in turn. A fashion-magazine word for making a wardrobe go further.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着回|きまわ}す。
examples.english: To mix and match a few clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{着回|きまわ}しやすい。
examples.english: This white shirt is easy to mix and match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{三着|さんちゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{着回|きまわ}した。
examples.english: During the trip, I mixed and matched three outfits well.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着回|きまわ}す; no intransitive pair

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着回|きまわ}しやすい: easy to mix and match
- ⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧{着回|きまわ}す: to get a week of outfits out of (a few items)
- ⟦{着回|きまわ}し→着回し：33337_kimawashi⟧⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧: the knack of mixing and matching

FORMS:
- ⟦{着回|きまわ}し→着回し：33337_kimawashi⟧: the noun, mixing and matching clothes
